description:
In crates/sieve-native/src/evaluator.rs, eval_header_test clones ctx.headers (the full parsed header map) on every invocation. For a message with many Sieve tests (e.g. a script with multiple header comparisons) this produces O(headers × tests) heap allocations per message delivery.

Fix: change eval_header_test to accept a shared reference to the headers (&HashMap<...>) and iterate without cloning. If the test logic requires ownership in some branch, clone lazily only in that branch rather than at the top of the function.
title: sieve-native: eval_header_test clones header map on every call
